t: Global buys Primesight and Outdoor Plus in stunning double deal
s: April 26, 2019 - The double Primesight/Outdoor Plus deal expands Global far beyond its traditional heartlands of radio, digital audio and festivals. It means the two OOH companies will add nearly £100m in revenue to Global, increasing the group's turnover by roughly a third from its existing turnover of about £300m, according to its last accounts. Global described the deal as its "most significant acquisition" since buying its radio business.
